hooks.description: NDF: notify when the main directory is edited
NDF: stop polling waits and ask a long conductor to continue in a new session

hooks.command: sh -c '[ -n "${NDF_RELAY_DIR:-}" ] || exit 0; ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$ROOT/scripts/relay.py" question open'
hooks.description: NDF: under the relay, mark that a question is shown so the relay never types into it

hooks.command: sh -c '[ -n "${NDF_RELAY_DIR:-}" ] || exit 0; ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$ROOT/scripts/relay.py" question close'
hooks.description: NDF: under the relay, clear the question mark after the answer
NDF: set default statusline when none is configured
NDF: report stray changes in the main directory and follow the active worktree branch

hooks.command: sh -c 'R="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/ndf/relay/rc-added"; C="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/ndf/relay.py"; N="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/ndf/relay.py"; [ -f "$R" ] || [ -f "$C" ] || [ -f "$N" ] || exit 0; ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || exit 0; python3 "$ROOT/scripts/relay.py" startup; exit 0'
hooks.description: NDF: refresh an existing relay copy (never downgrade) and tell once about the alias 10.17.4 added automatically

hooks.command: sh -c 'ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -n "$ROOT" ]; then node "$ROOT/scripts/slack-notify.js" session_end; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Send Slack notification when Claude Code exits

hooks.command: sh -c '[ -n "${NDF_RELAY_DIR:-}" ] || exit 0; ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || exit 0; python3 "$ROOT/scripts/relay.py" mark; exit 0'
hooks.description: NDF: under the relay, copy the ndf-next block of the last reply to the relay mark
